unite_adi: REGULAR UPPER SECONDARY-YEAR 12-LEVEL: B1.4 THEME 3: FAMILY LIFE & HOME

bolumler.ogrenmeKanitlari: PERFORMANCE ASSIGNMENT: Students will create a digital story exploring the theme ''Family Life and Home'' with a focus on the impact of technology on family life and the relationships between the family and community. They will illustrate how modern technologies, such as smartphones, social media, and smart home devices, have changed the way families interact, both positively and negatively. Students will also examine how families connect with their communities, considering the role of technology in enhancing or hindering these relationships. The project should creatively describe real-life or scenarios that highlight the balance between embracing technology and maintaining meaningful connections within the family and community. The assignment will be evaluated by using a rubric scheme, a rating scale, and/or a marking scheme. Öğrenme-Öğretme Yaşantıları
bolumler.temelKabuller: This theme includes the concept of ''family life and home with its components such as the impact of technology on family life; the relationships between the family and community'' and it is assumed that it could be present in almost all languages, with some exceptions. It is assumed that a student of an upper secondary school in year 12 may know what the impact of technology on family life; the relationships between the family and community mean in their own language as it is known that almost all people who start to learn a new language bring their pre-existing knowledge (in their own language) with them and transfer it to their new language learning context. However, they may not know how to say these things in a foreign language if this has not yet been covered in their existing curriculum. Fortunately, this existing knowledge in their own language can help them recognise, understand, and learn them more easily in a foreign language, in this case English. As they are students of an upper secondary school in year 12, they are expected to know some basic vocabulary about ''family life and home'' in English from previous themes and/or years such as ''family gatherings, occasion, anniversary, privacy, responsibility'' and also some structures such as ''The family had celebrated their anniversary before they moved to a new city. He hadn’t cleaned up the mess before the guests arrived for the family meal.'' in English from the previous themes or years. These grammatical items and vocabulary are revised during the ''Revision Programme'' at the beginning of the year and they can be used as a basis for learning the new vocabulary and grammatical items in the current theme, so that the new grammatical elements in the current theme can be learnt easily.
bolumler.onDegerlendirme: It is assumed that these students in an upper secondary school are ready to learn the concept of ''the impact of technology on family life; the relationships between the family and community'' cognitively, affectively, and socially since it is appropriate to their age and language level. Therefore, a contextual poster or a large picture could be provided for the students to remember and practise the items that they are related and previously learnt so that they can discuss the poster and/or the picture in pairs and write down what they remember. This session can help them revise all the related vocabulary and grammatical elements that they have already learnt from previous themes or from previous years as a preparatory practice. In this way, their performance can be evaluated in terms of how much they remember and how accurately they use these items to build their competence in the current theme. It can help the teacher decide what to emphasise, revise, and practise in order to facilitate the new vocabulary and grammatical items in the current theme. (Their performance can be evaluated by rubrics, a rating scale, and /or a marking scheme during these practices.).
bolumler.zenginlestirme: Objective: To create a timeline of how technology has impacted family life in English by using the target vocabulary and target grammar. Activity 1: Technology and Family Life Timeline The teacher introduces the activity. Students explore how technology has impacted family life over the years by using three important past tenses: the simple past, past progressive, and past perfect. Technology has transformed the way families connect, communicate, and spend time together. Students think about how families used landline phones in the 1980s, how video calls became common in the 2000s, and how social media now plays a major role. The activity involves working in pairs to create a timeline of these changes. For each key event, write a simple past sentence to describe the event (e.g., ''In the 1980s, families used landline phones''), a past progressive sentence to show ongoing activities at the time (e.g., ''While families were watching TV in the 1990s, they were spending time together''), and a past perfect sentence to explain what had happened before the event (e.g., ''By the time smartphones became popular, families had already started using email''). Once the timelines are complete, share and discuss the ideas with the class to see how technology has influenced family life. In the end, the teacher provides constructive feedback on the content and use of target vocabulary and target grammar. Students reflect on their thoughts and feelings about the activity.
bolumler.destekleme: Objective: To describe positive and negative effects of technology on family life in English by using target vocabulary. Activity 1: Grouping the Effects of Technology on Family Life The teacher prepares a reading text for this activity. Students read the text below or another text and underline the positive and negative effects of technology on family life. After reading, they group these effects under two headings: ''Positive Effects'' and ''Negative Effects''. Finally, each student shares one positive and one negative effect with the class. In the end, the teacher provides constructive feedback on the content and use of vocabulary. Activity Text: Technology, such as smartphones, video calls, and social media, helps families stay in touch, work, and study online, making life convenient and timesaving. It also allows families to monitor health and track kids. However, it can reduce face-to-face interaction, cause distractions, and lead to issues like sleep problems, technology addiction, and anxiety. To avoid these problems, families can set boundaries, play board games, or do outdoor activities. By using technology responsibly, families can strengthen bonds and connect with the community, sharing values and building unity. Students reflect on their thoughts and feelings about the activity.
